title: Turn out in full force!
flavor: While most heroes would be daunted by the misty forest in Drodo Island, Hoodwink masters its tangled paths. She and her fellow hunters are always ready to strike down any who dare threaten them, piercing their enemies’ armor with their precise archery. And all the inhabitants of Drodo Island are also taking action, drawing strength from the battle and becoming even more powerful.

entries.name: All model resources are dynamically loaded to prevent redundant loading cost. This helps for a great improvement in chances for successfully reconnecting
Chess pieces’ pathfinding algorithm optimized. They look much more clever now
Outdated Gamerules removed
entries.detail: You cannot recruit a certain piece when you have a Rank 3 piece of it already.

entries.name: Hoodwink - Acorn Shot
entries.detail: Reworked Hoodwink attacked with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, bouncing it to several nearby threatening enemy chess pieces, dealing physical damage, and granting a 100% chance for probable effects of all allies’ synergy on its victims.

entries.name: Oracle - Rain of Destiny
entries.detail: CD decreased from 20/15/12s to 15/12/10s

entries.name: Earthshaker - Fissure
entries.detail: Damage decreased from 250/400/550 to 150/300/600

entries.name: Terrorblade - Metamorphosis
entries.detail: Transformed allies are now non-permanent pieces which last for 60s.

entries.name: Meepo - Poof
entries.detail: Damage increased from 100/200/400 to 150/300/600

entries.name: Razor - Plasma field
entries.detail: Max damage increased from 100/175/250 to 150/225/300

entries.name: Leshrac - Pulse Nova
entries.detail: Radius decreased from 300/350/400 to 250/300/350, damage per second decreased from 100/125/150 to 75/100/125

entries.name: Necrophos - Reapers Scythe
entries.detail: Rank 1 damage decreased from 400+40% to 300+30%, while Rank 2 and 3 are not changed.

entries.name: Ringmaster - Spotlight
entries.detail: Damage on non-permanent pieces decreased from 10%/15%/20% to 8%/12%/16%

entries.name: Omniknight - Guardian Angel
entries.detail: Allies protected by angels gains an instant heal of 200/300/400, while damage reduction percentage decreased from 50/70/90% to 40/60/80%

entries.name: IO - Tether
entries.detail: Cannot tether with Totems now. Damage reduction percentage decreased from 10/20/30% to 10/15/20%, health redistribution interval increased from 5/4/2s to 5/4/3s

entries.name: Hunter - Aimed Shot
entries.detail: Reworked. (3) Hunters: Every attack of all ally hunters has a 30% chance to perform a precise shot, penetrates evasion and -3 armor, lasts for 5 seconds and is stackable. (6) Hunters: Every attack of all ally hunters has a 60% chance to perform a precise shot, penetrates evasion and -6 armor, lasts for 10 seconds and is stackable. (9) Hunters: Every precise shot will knock back the victim for 2 grids on hit and perform an extra attack.

entries.name: Warlock - Soul Leech
entries.detail: (4) strengthened and (6) reworked. (2) Warlocks: All allies have All allies have +5% lifesteal from all damage dealt. (4) Warlocks: All allies have All allies have +20% lifesteal from all damage dealt. (6) Warlocks: All ally warlocks steal a max health that equals to the damage on every attack.

entries.name: Naga - Scaled Armor
entries.detail: Can absorb all kinds of damage now (including pure damage)

entries.name: Warrior - Fortified Armor
entries.detail: (6) Warriors: +9 Armor instead of +12

entries.name: Elf - Evasion
entries.detail: (9) Elves: Illusion cannot extend Item effects, duration increased from 5s to 7s, CD increased from 4s to 5s

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
entries.detail: New tier 3 item. <Aura> All allies in radius gain effect: Attack speed +30%

entries.name: Glimmer Cape, Dragon Lance, Cloak of Tyrants
entries.detail: Temporarily removed.

entries.name: Tranquil Boots

entries.name: Lucky Pendant

entries.name: Gossamer Cape
entries.detail: Magical resistance +25% added.

entries.name: Telescope

entries.name: Mask of Madness

entries.detail: Duration increased from 4s to 5s

entries.name: Pavise
entries.detail: Triggers on damage taken instead of health under 50%

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.detail: Reworked. Block 25 physical damage. A melee carrier has a 50% chance to block extra 25 physical damage.

entries.name: Vladimir's Offering
entries.detail: Downgraded from T3 to T2, lifesteal decreased from 30% to 25%

entries.name: Paladin Sword

entries.name: Crimson Guard
entries.detail: Normally blocks 25 damage instead of 30. Blocks 50 damage instead of 30 when activated. +5 armor, Block 25 damage. <Active ability: Activates when taking damage>Grants all allies within the range 50 damage block and +5 armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

entries.name: Radiance
